chunks.sanskrit: sa naḥ̍ pi̠teva̍ sū̠nave'gne̎ sūpāya̠no bha̍va |
vāyo̠ tava̍ prapṛñca̠tī dhenā̎ jigāti dā̠śuṣe̎ |
indra̍vāyū i̠me su̠tā upa̠ prayo̎bhi̠rā ga̍tam |
mi̠traṃ hu̍ve pū̠tada̍kṣaṃ̠ varu̍ṇaṃ ca ri̠śāda̍sam |
indrā yā̎hi citrabhāno su̠tā i̠me tvā̠yavaḥ̍ |
indrā yā̎hi̠ tūtu̍jāna̠ upa̠ brahmā̎ṇi harivaḥ |
viśve̎ de̠vāso̎ a̠pturaḥ̍ su̠tamā ga̎nta̠ tūrṇa̍yaḥ |
ma̠ho arṇaḥ̠ sara̍svatī̠ pra ce̎tayati ke̠tunā̎ |
upa̍ naḥ̠ sava̠nā ga̍hi̠ soma̍sya somapāḥ piba |
mā no̠ ati̍ khya̠ ā ga̍hi || 3 ||
taṃ tvā̠ vāje̎ṣu vā̠jinaṃ̎ vā̠jayā̎maḥ śatakrato |
ā tvetā̠ ni ṣī̎da̠tendra̍ma̠bhi pra gā̎yata |
sa ghā̎ no̠ yoga̠ ā bhu̍va̠tsa rā̠ye sa puraṃ̎dhyām |
yasya̍ saṃ̠sthe na vṛ̠ṇvate̠ harī̎ sa̠matsu̠ śatra̍vaḥ |
su̠ta̠pāvne̎ su̠tā i̠me śuca̍yo yanti vī̠taye̎ |
tvaṃ su̠tasya̍ pī̠taye̎ sa̠dyo vṛ̠ddho a̍jāyathāḥ |
ā tvā̎ viśantvā̠śavaḥ̠ somā̎sa indra girvaṇaḥ |
mā no̠ martā̎ a̠bhi dru̍han ta̠nūnā̎mindra girvaṇaḥ |
indre̎ṇa̠ saṃ hi dṛkṣa̍se saṃjagmā̠no abi̍bhyuṣā |
i̠to vā̎ sā̠timīma̍he di̠vo vā̠ pārthi̍vā̠dadhi̍ |
indra̠ iddharyoḥ̠ sacā̠ sammi̍śla̠ ā va̍co̠yujā̎ |
indro̎ dī̠rghāya̠ cakṣa̍sa̠ ā sūryaṃ̎ rohayaddi̠vi |
sa no̎ vṛṣanna̠muṃ ca̠ruṃ satrā̎dāva̠nnapā̎ vṛdhi |
tu̠ñjetu̎ñje̠ ya utta̍re̠ stomā̠ indra̍sya va̠jriṇaḥ̍ |
ni yena̍ muṣṭiha̠tyayā̠ ni vṛ̠trā ru̠ṇadhā̎mahai |
indra̠ tvotā̎sa̠ ā va̠yaṃ vajraṃ̎ gha̠nā da̍dīmahi |
ma̠hām̐ indraḥ̍ pa̠raśca̠ nu ma̍hi̠tvama̍stu va̠jriṇe̎ |
sa̠mo̠he vā̠ ya āśa̍ta̠ nara̍sto̠kasya̠ sani̍tau |
yaḥ ku̠kṣiḥ so̎ma̠pāta̍maḥ samu̠dra i̍va̠ pinva̍te |
e̠vā hya̍sya sū̠nṛtā̎ vira̠pśī goma̍tī ma̠hī |
e̠vā hi te̠ vibhū̎taya ū̠taya̍ indra̠ māva̍te |
e̠vā hya̍sya̠ kāmyā̠ stoma̍ u̠kthaṃ ca̠ śaṃsyā̎ |
a̠smān tsu tatra̍ coda̠yendra̍ rā̠ye rabha̍svataḥ |
saṃ goma̍dindra̠ vāja̍vada̠sme pṛ̠thu śravo̎ bṛ̠hat |
yu̠kṣvā hi ke̠śinā̠ harī̠ vṛṣa̍ṇā kakṣya̠prā |
athā̎ na indra somapā gi̠rāmupa̍śrutiṃ cara || 3 ||
ehi̠ stomām̐̎ a̠bhi sva̍rā̠bhi gṛ̍ṇī̠hyā ru̍va |
brahma̍ ca no vaso̠ sacendra̍ ya̠jñaṃ ca̍ vardhaya || 4 ||
śa̠kro yathā̎ su̠teṣu̍ ṇo rā̠raṇa̍t sa̠khyeṣu̍ ca || 5 ||
tamit sa̍khi̠tva ī̎mahe̠ taṃ rā̠ye taṃ su̠vīrye̎ |
sa śa̠kra u̠ta naḥ̍ śaka̠dindro̠ vasu̠ daya̍mānaḥ || 6 ||
gavā̠mapa̎ vra̠jaṃ vṛ̍dhi kṛṇu̠ṣva rādho̎ adrivaḥ || 7 ||
jeṣaḥ̠ sva̎rvatīra̠paḥ saṃ gā a̠smabhyaṃ̎ dhūnuhi || 8 ||
āśru̍tkarṇa śru̠dhī havaṃ̠ nū ci̍ddadhiṣva me̠ giraḥ̍ |
vi̠dmā hi tvā̠ vṛṣa̎ntamaṃ̠ vāje̎ṣu havana̠śruta̎m |
ā tū na̍ indra kauśika mandasā̠naḥ su̠taṃ pi̍ba |
pari̍ tvā girvaṇo̠ gira̍i̠mā bha̍vantu vi̠śvataḥ̍ |
sa̠khye ta̍ indra vā̠jino̠ mā bhe̎ma śavasaspate |
pū̠rvīrindra̍sya rā̠tayo̠ na vi da̍syan tyū̠tayaḥ̍ |
yadī̠ vāja̍sya̠ goma̍taḥ sto̠tṛbhyo̠ maṃha̍te ma̠gham || 3 ||
indro̠ viśva̍sya̠ karma̍ṇo dha̠rtā va̠jrī pu̍ruṣṭu̠taḥ || 4 ||
sa̠hasraṃ̠ yasya̍ rā̠taya̍ u̠ta vā̠ santi̠ bhūya̍sīḥ || 8 ||
agne̎ de̠vām̐ i̠hā va̍ha jajñā̠no vṛ̠ktaba̎rhiṣe |
tām̐ u̍śa̠to vi bo̎dhaya̠ yada̍gne̠ yāsi̍ dū̠tya̎m |
ghṛtā̎havana dīdivaḥ̠ prati̍ ṣma̠ riṣa̍to daha |
sa naḥ̍ pāvaka dīdi̠vo'gne̎ de̠vām̐ i̠hā va̍ha |
sa naḥ̠ stavā̎na̠ ā bha̍ra gāya̠treṇa̠ navī̎yasā |
susa̍middho na̠ ā va̍ha de̠vām̐ a̍gne ha̠viṣma̍te |
madhu̍mantaṃ tanūnapād ya̠jñaṃ de̠veṣu̍ naḥ kave |
agne̎ su̠khata̍me̠ rathe̎ de̠vām̐ ī̎ḷi̠ta ā va̍ha |
tā su̍ji̠hvā upa̍ hvaye̠ hotā̎rā̠ daivyā̎ ka̠vī |
ava̍ sṛjā vanaspate̠ deva̍ de̠vebhyo̎ ha̠viḥ |
ā tvā̠ kaṇvā̎ ahūṣata gṛ̠ṇanti̍ vipra te̠ dhiyaḥ̍ |
pra vo̎ bhriyanta̠ inda̍vo matsa̠rā mā̎dayi̠ṣṇavaḥ̍ |
ghṛ̠tapṛ̍ṣṭhā mano̠yujo̠ ye tvā̠ vaha̎nti̠ vahna̍yaḥ |
ye yaja̍trā̠ ya īḍyā̠s te te̎ pibantu ji̠hvayā̎ |
yu̠kṣvā hyaru̍ṣī̠ rathe̎ ha̠rito̎ deva ro̠hitaḥ̍ |
indra̠ somaṃ̠ piba̍ ṛ̠tunā '' tvā̎ viśa̠ntvinda̍vaḥ |
maru̍taḥ̠ piba̍ta ṛ̠tunā̎ po̠trād ya̠jñaṃ pu̍nītana |
a̠bhi ya̠jñaṃ gṛ̍ṇīhino̠ gnāvo̠ neṣṭaḥ̠ piba̍ ṛ̠tunā̎ |
agne̎ de̠vām̐ i̠hā va̍ha sā̠dayā̠ yoni̍ṣu tri̠ṣu |
dra̠vi̠ṇo̠dā da̍dātu no̠ vasū̎ni̠ yāni̍ śṛṇvi̠re |
dra̠vi̠ṇo̠dāḥ pi̍pīṣati ju̠hota̠ pra ca̍ tiṣṭhata |
ā tvā̎ vahantu̠ hara̍yo̠ vṛṣa̍ṇaṃ̠ soma̍pītaye |
i̠mā dhā̠nā ghṛ̍ta̠snuvo̠ harī̎ i̠hopa̍ vakṣataḥ |
upa̍ naḥ su̠tamā ga̍hi̠ hari̍bhirindra ke̠śibhiḥ̍ |
semaṃ naḥ̠ stoma̠mā ga̠hyupe̠daṃ sava̍naṃ su̠tam |
i̠me somā̎sa̠ inda̍vaḥ su̠tāso̠ adhi̍ ba̠rhiṣi̍ |
a̠yaṃ te̠ stomo̎ agri̠yo hṛ̍di̠spṛga̍stu̠ śaṃta̍maḥ |
semaṃ naḥ̠ kāma̠mā pṛ̍ṇa̠ gobhi̠raśvaiḥ̎ śatakrato |
gantā̎rā̠ hi sthova̍se̠ havaṃ̠ vipra̍sya̠ māva̍taḥ |
tayo̠ridava̍sā va̠yaṃ sa̠nema̠ ni ca̍ dhīmahi |
indrā̎varuṇa̠ nū nu vāṃ̠ siṣā̎santīṣu dhī̠ṣvā |
mā naḥ̠ śaṃso̠ ara̍ruṣo dhū̠rtiḥ praṇa̠ṅ martya̍sya |
sa ghā̎ vī̠ro na ri̍ṣyati̠ yamindro̠ brahma̍ṇa̠spatiḥ̍ |
tvaṃ taṃ bra̎hmaṇaspate̠ soma̠ indra̍śca̠ martya̎m |
prati̠ tyaṃ cāru̍madhva̠raṃ go̎pī̠thāya̠ pra hū̎yase |
na̠hi de̠vo na martyo̎ ma̠hastava̠ kratuṃ̎ pa̠raḥ |
ye ma̠ho raja̍so vi̠durviśve̎ de̠vāso̎ a̠druhaḥ̍ |
ye nāka̠syādhi̍ roca̠ne di̠vi de̠vāsa̠ āsa̍te |
ā ye ta̠nvanti̍ ra̠śmibhi̍s ti̠raḥ sa̍mu̠dramoja̍sā |
a̠bhi tvā̎ pū̠rvapī̎taye sṛ̠jāmi̍ so̠myaṃ madhu̍ |
saṃ vo̠ madā̎so agma̠tendre̎ṇa ca ma̠rutva̍tā |
u̠ta tyaṃ ca̍ma̠saṃ navaṃ̠ tvaṣṭu̍rde̠vasya̠ niṣkṛ̍tam |
te no̠ ratnā̎ni dhattana̠ trirā sāptā̎ni sunva̠te |
tā ya̠jñeṣu̠ pra śaṃ̎satendrā̠gnī śu̎mbhatā naraḥ |
tā mi̠trasya̠ praśa̍staya indrā̠gnī tā ha̍vāmahe |
u̠grā santā̎ havāmaha̠ upe̠daṃ sava̍naṃ su̠tam |
tā ma̠hāntā̠ sada̠spatī̠ indrā̎gnī̠ rakṣa̍ ubjatam |
na̠hi vā̠masti̍ dūra̠ke yatrā̠ rathe̎na̠ gaccha̍thaḥ |
sakhā̎ya̠ ā ni ṣī̎data savi̠tā stomyo̠ nu naḥ̍ |
ā gnā a̍gna i̠hāva̍se̠ hotrāṃ̎ yaviṣṭha̠ bhāra̍tīm |
a̠bhi no̎ de̠vīrava̍sā ma̠haḥ śarma̍ṇā nṛ̠patnīḥ̎ |
ma̠hī dyauḥ pṛ̍thi̠vī ca̍ na i̠maṃ ya̠jñaṃ mi̍mikṣatām |
tayo̠rid ghṛ̠tava̠t payo̠ viprā̎ rihanti dhī̠tibhiḥ̍ |
ato̎ de̠vā a̍vantu no̠ yato̠ viṣṇu̎rvicakra̠me |
i̠daṃ viṣṇu̠rvi ca̍krame tre̠dhā ni da̍dhe pa̠dam |
trīṇi̍ pa̠dā vi ca̍krame̠ viṣṇu̍rgo̠pā adā̎bhyaḥ |
viṣṇoḥ̠ karmā̎ṇi paśyata̠ yato̎ vra̠tāni̍ paspa̠śe |
tadviṣṇoḥ̎ para̠maṃ pa̠daṃ sadā̎ paśyanti sū̠rayaḥ̍ |
tī̠vrāḥ somā̎sa̠ ā ga̍hyā̠śīrva̎ntaḥ su̠tā i̠me |
ha̠ta vṛ̠traṃ su̍dānava̠ indre̎ṇa̠ saha̍sā yu̠jā |
a̠mūryā upa̠ sūrye̠ yābhi̎rvā̠ sūryaḥ̍ sa̠ha |
a̠po de̠vīrupa̍ hvaye̠ yatra̠ gāvaḥ̠ piba̎nti naḥ |
āpaḥ̍ pṛṇī̠ta bhe̎ṣa̠jaṃ varū̎thaṃ ta̠nve̠3̍(e̠) mama̍ |
i̠damā̎paḥ̠ pra va̍hata̠ yat kiṃ ca̍ duri̠taṃ mayi̍ |
yad vā̠hama̍bhidu̠droha̠ yad vā̎ śe̠pa u̠tānṛ̍tam || 22 ||
paya̍svānagna̠ ā ga̍hi̠ taṃ mā̠ saṃ sṛ̍ja̠ varca̍sā || 23 ||
saṃ mā̎gne̠ varca̍sā sṛja̠ saṃ pra̠jayā̠ samāyu̍ṣā |
vi̠dyurme̎ asya de̠vā indro̎ vidyāt sa̠ha ṛṣi̍bhiḥ || 24 ||
kasya̍ nū̠naṃ ka̍ta̠masyā̠mṛtā̎nāṃ̠ manā̎mahe̠ cāru̍ de̠vasya̠ nāma̍ |
ko no̎ ma̠hyā adi̍taye̠ puna̍rdāt pi̠taraṃ̎ ca dṛ̠śeyaṃ̎ mā̠taraṃ̎ ca || 1 ||
a̠gnerva̠yaṃ pra̍tha̠masyā̠mṛtā̎nāṃ̠ manā̎mahe̠ cāru̍ de̠vasya̠ nāma̍ |
sa no̎ ma̠hyā adi̍taye̠ puna̍rdāt pi̠taraṃ̎ ca dṛ̠śeyaṃ̎ mā̠taraṃ̎ ca || 2 ||
yaści̠ddhi ta̍ i̠tthā bhagaḥ̍ śaśamā̠naḥ pu̠rā ni̠daḥ |
na̠hi te̎ kṣa̠traṃ na saho̠ na ma̠nyuṃ vaya̍śca̠nāmī pa̠taya̎nta ā̠puḥ |
nemā āpo̎ animi̠ṣaṃ cara̎ntī̠rna ye vāta̍sya prami̠nantyabhva̎m || 6 ||
a̠bu̠dhne rājā̠ varu̍ṇo̠ vana̍syo̠rdhvaṃ stūpaṃ̎ dadate pū̠tada̍kṣaḥ |
nī̠cīnāḥ̎ sthuru̠pari̍ bu̠dhna e̎ṣāma̠sme a̠ntarnihi̍tāḥ ke̠tavaḥ̍ syuḥ || 7 ||
u̠ruṃ hi rājā̠ varu̍ṇaśca̠kāra̠ sūryā̎ya̠ panthā̠manve̎ta̠vā u̍ |
śa̠taṃ te̎ rājan bhi̠ṣajaḥ̍ sa̠hasra̍mu̠rvī ga̍bhī̠rā su̍ma̠tiṣṭe̎ astu |
bādha̍sva dū̠re nirṛ̍tiṃ parā̠caiḥ kṛ̠taṃ ci̠denaḥ̠ pra mu̍mugdhya̠smat || 9 ||
a̠mī ya ṛkṣā̠ nihi̍tāsa u̠ccā naktaṃ̠ dadṛ̍śre̠ kuha̍ ci̠ddive̎yuḥ |
tattvā̎ yāmi̠ brahma̍ṇā̠ vanda̍māna̠s tadā śā̎ste̠ yaja̍māno ha̠virbhiḥ̍ |
ahe̎ḷamāno varuṇe̠ha bo̠dhyuru̍śaṃsa̠ mā na̠ āyuḥ̠ pra mo̎ṣīḥ || 11 ||
tadinnaktaṃ̠ taddivā̠ mahya̍māhu̠s tada̠yaṃ keto̎ hṛ̠da ā vi ca̍ṣṭe |
śunaḥ̠śepo̠ yamahva̍d gṛbhī̠taḥ so a̠smān rājā̠ varu̍ṇo mumoktu || 12 ||
śunaḥ̠śepo̠ hyahva̍d gṛbhī̠tas tri̠ṣvā̎di̠tyaṃ dru̍pa̠deṣu̍ ba̠ddhaḥ |
avai̎naṃ̠ rājā̠ varu̍ṇaḥ sasṛjyād vi̠dvām̐ ada̍bdho̠ vi mu̍moktu̠ pāśā̍n || 13 ||
ava̍ te̠ heḷo̎ varuṇa̠ namo̎bhi̠rava̍ ya̠jñebhi̍rīmahe ha̠virbhiḥ̍ |
udu̍tta̠maṃ va̍ruṇa̠ pāśa̍ma̠smadavā̎dha̠maṃ vi ma̍dhya̠maṃ śra̍thāya |
athā̎ va̠yamā̎ditya vra̠te tavānā̎gaso̠ adi̍taye syāma || 15 ||
yacci̠ddhi te̠ viśo̎ yathā̠ pra de̎va varuṇa vra̠tam |
mā no̎ va̠dhāya̍ ha̠tnave̎ jihīḷā̠nasya̍ rīradhaḥ |
vi mṛ̍ḷī̠kāya̍ te̠ mano̎ ra̠thīraśvaṃ̠ na saṃdi̍tam |
parā̠ hi me̠ vima̎nyavaḥ̠ pata̎nti̠ vasya̍iṣṭaye |
tadit sa̍mā̠namā̎śāte̠ vena̎ntā̠ na pra yu̍cchataḥ |
sa no̎ vi̠śvāhā̎ su̠kratu̍rādi̠tyaḥ su̠pathā̎ karat |
na yaṃ dipsa̎nti di̠psavo̠ na druhvā̎ṇo̠ janā̎nām |
parā̎ me yanti dhī̠tayo̠ gāvo̠ na gavyū̎tī̠ranu̍ |
saṃ nu vo̎cāvahai̠ puna̠ryato̎ me̠ madhvābhṛ̍tam |
darśaṃ̠ nu vi̠śvada̍rśataṃ̠ darśaṃ̠ ratha̠madhi̠ kṣami̍ |
i̠maṃ me̎ varuṇa śrudhī̠ hava̍ma̠dyā ca̍ mṛḷaya |
tvaṃ viśva̍sya medhira di̠vaśca̠ gmaśca̍ rājasi |
udu̍tta̠maṃ mu̍mugdhi no̠ vi pāśaṃ̎ madhya̠maṃ cṛ̍ta |
ni no̠ hotā̠ vare̎ṇyaḥ̠ sadā̎ yaviṣṭha̠ manma̍bhiḥ |
ā no̎ ba̠rhī ri̠śāda̍so̠ varu̍ṇo mi̠tro a̎rya̠mā |
pūrvya̍ hotara̠sya no̠ manda̍sva sa̠khyasya̍ ca |
pri̠yo no̎ astu vi̠śpati̠rhotā̎ ma̠ndro vare̎ṇyaḥ |
sva̠gnayo̠ hi vāryaṃ̎ de̠vāso̎ dadhi̠re ca̍ naḥ |
aśvaṃ̠ na tvā̠ vāra̍vantaṃ va̠ndadhyā̎ a̠gniṃ namo̎bhiḥ |
sa ghā̎ naḥ sū̠nuḥ śava̍sā pṛ̠thupra̍gāmā su̠śevaḥ̍ |
i̠mamū̠ ṣu tvama̠smākaṃ̎ sa̠niṃ gā̎ya̠traṃ navyāṃ̎sam |
ā no̎ bhaja para̠meṣvā vāje̎ṣu madhya̠meṣu̍ |
yama̍gne pṛ̠tsu martya̠mavā̠ vāje̎ṣu̠ yaṃ ju̠nāḥ |
sa no̎ ma̠hām̐ a̍nimā̠no dhū̠make̎tuḥ puruśca̠ndraḥ |
sa re̠vām̐ i̍va vi̠śpati̠rdaivyaḥ̍ ke̠tuḥ śṛ̍ṇotu naḥ |
namo̎ ma̠hadbhyo̠ namo̎ arbha̠kebhyo̠ namo̠ yuva̍bhyo̠ nama̍ āśi̠nebhyaḥ̍ |
yajā̎ma de̠vān yadi̍ śa̠knavā̎ma̠ mā jyāya̍saḥ̠ śaṃsa̠mā vṛ̍kṣi devāḥ || 13 ||
yatra̠ grāvā̎ pṛ̠thubu̍dhna ū̠rdhvo bhava̍ti̠ sota̍ve |
yatra̠ manthāṃ̎ viba̠dhnate̎ ra̠śmīn yami̍ta̠vā i̍va |
u̠ta sma̍ te vanaspate̠ vāto̠ vi vā̠tyagra̠mit |
tā no̎ a̠dya va̍naspatī ṛ̠ṣvāvṛ̠ṣvebhiḥ̍ so̠tṛbhiḥ̍ |
ucchi̠ṣṭaṃ ca̠mvo̎rbhara̠ somaṃ̎ pa̠vitra̠ ā sṛ̍ja |
yacci̠ddhi sa̍tya somapā anāśa̠stā i̍va̠ smasi̍ |

sa̠santu̠ tyā arā̎tayo̠ bodha̎ntu śūra rā̠tayaḥ̍ |
